week.name: Thanksgiving Day
week.detailed: Patchy fog after 9am. Mostly sunny. High near 45, with temperatures falling to around 41 in the afternoon. South wind around 2 mph.

week.name: Friday
week.short: Patchy Fog then Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: Patchy fog before 2pm, then a chance of rain. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 45. South southwest wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: A chance of rain and snow before 8am, then a chance of rain and snow between 8am and 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 43. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 46.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Rain. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 45.
week.night_short: Chance Light Rain then Chance Rain And Snow

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: A chance of rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 47.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Rain likely before 8am, then rain and snow likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 43.
